read_contract.freshness_rule: Immutable evidence record of the 2026-07-02 stale-ADR archive sweep; never edited after the fact. The live enforcement is the read-surface resurrection lane of cloud-ci-cross-artifact-agreement over the current tree.

sub_ac: Seed Sub-AC 5.3.1 — identify all wholly-stale/superseded ADRs under docs/decisions/, archive each with a provenance record (original path, supersession reason, superseding artifact), and update the decisions index/machine-readable decisions.json accordingly

identification.predicate: Mechanical: an ADR under docs/decisions/ is wholly stale/superseded iff its decision status resolves to Superseded (the ADR shape-kernel status vocabulary, libs/oya-governance-adr-shape-kernel); evaluated over the full 419-record decision corpus.
identification.cross_check: The sweep set equals the union of the Superseded status counts in the regenerated machine mirror docs/machine-readable/decisions.json (Superseded 34 + superseded 1 = 35).

archive_mechanism.rationale: docs/decisions/ADR-*.md is the immutable decision-record home (masterplan planning_authority.decision_record_authority); moving files would break the generated-index projection, ADR-number citations, and reciprocal supersession edges, so archival is in place behind mechanical markers rather than by relocation.
archive_mechanism.provenance_ledger: /specs/masterplan.json#masterplan_v2.surface_dispositions — one archived-with-provenance row per swept ADR carrying original_path, supersession_reason, superseding_artifacts, staleness_evaluation, and provenance
archive_mechanism.resurrection_gate: cloud-ci-cross-artifact-agreement/masterplan-v2-read-surface-resurrection fails closed with masterplan_read_contract_invalid when any archived ADR drops its non-live declaration, canonical pointer, or provenance-archive read-timing declaration
